title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.03280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. translated_title: 特异性偏差与维基百科悖论：域偏移下AI文本检测器的可解释AI（xAI）分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.03280v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的广泛使用要求能够可靠地区分人类撰写文本与合成文本。然而，当前基于Transformer的检测器在域偏移（domain shift）情况下往往出现严重的性能下降，并且作为不透明的分类器运行。本文研究了经过微调的Transformer模型（DistilBERT、RoBERTa）的鲁棒性与可解释性，方法是将它们在自定义的分布外（OOD）数据集上进行评估，该数据集由通过开源大语言模型（Llama 3、Mistral、Gemma）合成的超本地新闻组成。为分析模型的决策边界，我们应用了基于SHAP的三方可解释AI（xAI）框架。我们的分析揭示了三个关键现象：首先，检测器往往依赖于指令微调LLM所固有的“行动号召”（Call-to-Action）特征，而非通用的机器文本特征。其次，我们观察到一种“特异性偏差”（Specificity Bias），即LLM通过幻觉出特定的命名实体并模仿具体……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过基于SHAP的可解释AI框架发现，AI文本检测器在域偏移下主要依赖指令微调大模型特有的“行动号召”风格而非通用机器文本特征进行判断，且大语言模型可通过幻觉出特定命名实体的“特异性偏差”策略绕过检测。
en_tdlr: Using an xAI framework based on SHAP, this paper shows that AI text detectors under domain shift rely on the "Call-to-Action" style characteristic of instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text, and that LLMs can evade detection through a "Specificity Bias" by hallucinating specific named entities.
